title: World Freehand Circle Drawing Champion
summary: A one-minute clip of Alexander Overwijk drawing a near-perfect freehand circle, one metre across, in under a second on a chalkboard. He is a repeat winner of the World Freehand Circle Drawing Championship.
why: HN uses it as the go-to example of an astonishingly perfect hand-drawn circle.

quote.text: Here's a video of Alexander Overwijk, who has won the World Freehand Circle Drawing Championship numerous times, drawing a circle
